🧊 Andy Burnham promises not to raise the basic, higher or additional rates of income tax, VAT or employee National Insurance.

😐 Hold him to it — but understand what that promise LEAVES OUT.

📌 The personal allowance has been frozen at £12,570 since 2021 and stays frozen to at least 2028. Wages move. Thresholds don't.

📊 The IFS expects 7.8 MILLION adults — 14% — to be paying higher-rate tax by 2027-28. Nurses. Police officers. Headteachers. Tradespeople.

🤫 No vote. No announcement. No minister ever has to defend it.

A tax rise you didn't vote for is still a tax rise. 👇
